notes.title: March Update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update 1.0.1[/b][/h1]

Thank you community for very well constructed feedback. I decide to make some changes in game. I decide to allow user from belowed contries has it own translations for games and also steam achievements. Enjoy gamming and try to beat Mariusz!

[olist]
[b][*] Added more graphic elements.
[*] Improved the background at level two.
[*] Language selection option added in the menu.
[*] Changed the font to a more user-friendly one.
[*] Steam achievements have been added.
[*] Added support for the following languages:[/b]
[/olist]
[list]
[*] Polish
[*] Chinese
[*] German
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Russian
[/list]
